qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the idler lever to alternator bracket replacement screw?
What type of screw is used for the idler lever to alternator bracket?
What is the torque value for the screw plug for bearing pin?
What type of screw plug is specified for the bearing pin?
Which component has the higher torque specification - the idler lever screw or the bearing pin screw plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The idler lever to alternator bracket screw has the higher torque specification at 90 Nm compared to the bearing pin screw plug at 20 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual is this torque specification table from?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11-20 Engine, specifically 11 28 V-ribbed belt with tension and deflection element.

qa_pairs.question: What is the screw specification mentioned in the Measure column for the idler lever?
How many different torque specifications are listed on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque specifications are listed: 90 Nm and 20 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What components are covered under the V-ribbed belt with tension and deflection element section?
qa_pairs.answer: The idler lever to alternator bracket replacement screw (1AZ) and the screw plug for bearing pin (2AZ).

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque values between the two specifications listed?
qa_pairs.answer: The difference is 70 Nm (90 Nm for the idler lever screw minus 20 Nm for the bearing pin screw plug).
